name: @ethixweb/voice-runtime
description: Voice Runtime (docs/24-runtime-orchestrator-contract.md) — the telephony/STT/TTS transport layer. A LiveKit Agents (Node.js) worker: answers the SIP call, converts audio<->text, and drives voice-orchestrator's 5-endpoint HTTP contract. Owns no conversation state, no LLM, no tool logic — text in, text out, per docs/02 §0's swap boundary.
